    <g transform="translate(195 282)">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 0 0;90 0 0;180 0 0;270 0 0;360 0 0" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <rect x="-3" y="104" width="6" height="18" rx="3" fill="#379D53">

      <rect x="-91" y="-91" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#EA4437">

    <rect x="0" y="568" width="390" height="276" fill="#000000" opacity=".3" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

      <text x="343" y="700" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#379D53">Готово</text>

      <circle cx="47" cy="746" r="10" fill="#7A4FF4"/>
      <rect x="43" y="742" width="8" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF">

      <text x="68" y="751" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1E1E1E">Подготовка нейросети</text>

    <g>
